verdict: Campaigns restarted strong at $12.65 per lead — still early, watching closely.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns came back online October 22nd after a pause earlier in the month, so all 19 leads and $240 in spend are effectively a 7-day account — not a full 28-day picture. At $12.65 per lead, the opening cost is healthy, though the last three days showed a mild softening in lead volume as daily spend climbed, which is normal in an early learning phase. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile engagement jumped 34% week over week, but call rates across all three profiles remain low, meaning profile visitors are browsing without picking up the phone. We're monitoring both the paid pacing and the GBP call gap closely as the campaign builds toward a reliable baseline next period.
